title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd explodes with excited cheers for Mihono Bourbon at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give Rice Shower some advice on how to keep focused even when the crowd isn't on her side.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to catch up to Mihono Bourbon, she turns her full attention to the race.
